description: Prepare individual and business returns in the tax software from client source documents; reviewer sign-off; extensions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $10,500 billed per business day from February to April; the April 15 and October 15 deadlines leave no slack in the last week; late returns or extensions bring penalties for clients
manual_workaround: File extensions for returns that cannot be finished; work from laptops at home if the office is closed
dependent_third_parties: Tax software vendor; productivity suite vendor; internet provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner CPA; Senior Tax Accountant; Tax Accountant; Tax Preparer; office suite

description: Collect signed Forms 8879 through the portal; transmit returns and extensions through the tax software vendor; track IRS and state acknowledgments and rejects
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A return is not filed until the IRS acknowledges it; deadline-day transmissions cannot wait more than a day; Forms 8879 must be kept 3 years (IRS Pub. 1345)
manual_workaround: Paper Form 8879 signed in the office or by mail; transmit from any clean laptop once the tax software is reachable
dependent_third_parties: Tax software vendor (Authorized IRS e-file Provider and transmitter); portal vendor; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Client Services Coordinator; Owner CPA (Responsible Official)

business_process: Client document intake and return delivery
description: Receive source documents through the portal, email, and the front desk; scan paper on the MFP; deliver finished returns and engagement letters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Preparers stop when documents cannot be received; scans made since the last sync could be lost; email delivery of returns is the main confidentiality exposure
manual_workaround: Clients drop off paper and it is scanned later; returns delivered on paper in the office with an ID check
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-06 (MFP and reception desktop); SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Portal vendor; productivity suite vendor; MFP lessor; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Client Services Coordinator; seasonal assistant (in season)

description: Enter hours and changes; approve payroll runs in the payroll platform; payroll tax deposits and filings for 38 clients (about 420 employees)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients' employees must be paid on the pay date; late payroll tax deposits bring penalties for clients; most pay dates fall on Fridays; payroll input worksheets live in SYS-03
manual_workaround: Run payroll from any clean laptop; repeat the prior period for salaried employees with client approval; payroll platform support line
dependent_third_parties: Payroll platform vendor; productivity suite vendor; internet provider

description: Record transactions and reconcile accounts in clients' cloud accounting platforms; month-end reports to clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Month-end reports can slip a few days; the data lives in the clients' own platforms
manual_workaround: Catch up after restore; tell clients that reports will be late

description: Answer IRS and state notices; represent clients in examinations under powers of attorney
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice response periods are usually measured in weeks; a missed response can lead to an assessment against the client; notice files live in SYS-03
manual_workaround: Call the IRS practitioner line to ask for more time; work from paper copies of notices
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; tax software vendor

description: Phone calls; email with clients; portal messages; appointment scheduling in season
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients must be able to reach the firm in season; email is how most clients send documents and where call-back verification starts
manual_workaround: Forward the office line to the Office Manager's cell phone; post a portal notice; call clients from the printed client list
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; phone carrier; portal vendor

description: Invoices and collections in the practice management system; firm payroll through an outside payroll service; vendor payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Billing can wait a week; the cash reserve covers about 45 days; firm payroll runs biweekly
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior firm payroll through the payroll service; invoice after restore
dependent_third_parties: Practice management vendor; outside payroll service
